name: 800G active electrical cable (AEC)

sources.title: Converge Digest: Credo introduces 800G AECs with 7 m length

summary: Copper cable with retimers in each end, bridging the gap between DAC and optics up to about 7 m.

reachM.note: Credo HiWire 800G AECs are offered up to 7 m.

powerWPerEnd.note: Credo 800G SPAN AEC product briefs list about 10 W typical per end; the brief URL was not reachable for citation.

capexUsdPerM.note: Judgment: a 5 m 800G AEC sells for roughly 400–700 USD.
